description: Get autocomplete suggestions for a seed keyword from the App Store or Google Play. Returns terms with a priority score (higher = more searched). Lighter and faster than sonar_keyword_search — use when you only need term ideas without difficulty/popularity scoring. Works without an API key (free tier, limited daily use per IP). If the store is throttling, the result may be Sonar's stored copy: it then comes back as `{ data, meta }` with `meta.stale: true`, its date in `meta.stale_as_of`, and a `meta.note` to pass on to the user.

country.description: Market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "mt"). Nearly every App Store storefront and Google Play market works; the few small storefronts that are not supported return an error naming them. Default "us".

seed.description: Seed keyword. The store will return autocomplete suggestions starting from this term.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

name: sonar_keyword_suggestions
title: Keyword Suggestions
